description: Remote guard. When the project is local-only (.enabler/local-only exists, or git.local_only is true in .enabler/config.json) it blocks git push, gh/glab writes, write requests to GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, and writes through GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira or Confluence MCP tools. Does nothing otherwise. Source guard, always on: refuses edits inside the external sources registered in .enabler/sources/sources.json, which the pipeline only reads.
